text:
priya: quick check — console PR needs a header change that depends on a runtime layout tweak. blocking: runtime PR + SDK compatibility patch. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inc/console/pull/482 https://github.com/redwood-inc/runtime/pull/310 https://github.com/redwood-inc/sdk/pull/212
mike: ok, pinged for review. do we need a feature flag toggle here? :thinking:
priya: we added `console.feature.useNewHeader = false` by default. no runtime feature flag. just helm values bump once runtime lands.
leah: helm chart will need appVersion + image tag bump. i can take the chart review but runtime must land first. putting runtime PR in my queue.
devendra: runtime PR #310 changes KV cache layout and header serialization; that broke SDK client header normalization. SDK PR #212 has a shim but tests failing. @sam can you confirm test status?
sam: running tests now — two integration failures. quick log:
```
AssertionError: expected header 'x-customer-id' but got 'x-cust'
```
sam: looks like header key mapping mismatch. i'll push a small normalization patch, should be <2h.
priya: proposed merge order: 1) SDK patch -> 2) merge runtime -> 3) bump helm & canary -> 4) merge console -> 5) 30m canary monitor -> full rollout. sound right?
mike: sounds good to me. i'll hold approval until sdk tests green.
leah: i can schedule helm canary at 16:30 UTC to keep risk window small. prefer that time.
merge-bot: automatic check: dependent PRs present, merge blocked until all approvals and CI pass.
priya: @mike @leah @sam please ping anyone needed on their PRs. i'll coordinate the final merge baton and post the sequence here.
sam: pushed SDK patch: https://github.com/redwood-inc/sdk/pull/215 — CI passing on latest run.
mike: reviewed console changes, looks safe. approved console PR #482 :thumbsup:
leah: runtime PR merged and helm chart published as v1.7.3; triggered chart repo update.
priya: kicking off console canary now, will share link in ~2m.
priya: canary link: https://canary.redwood-inference/internal/console/rollout/527 — initial checks/look OK
sam: noted — filing a follow-up e2e to assert header normalization across SDK consumers.
mike: after canary verified i'll merge console to main.
priya: canary stable, starting full rollout. monitoring latency/errors
priya: rollout complete, no regressions observed in first 45m. closing out this coordination thread. :tada:
